meta.title: User Attention
meta.description: Expresses the user's attention for the DSH Web client (online / away / offline): tracks mouse and keyboard activity, auto-downgrades after idling, and gates AI human interactions (approvals and questions). Provides approval/question timeout policies (reject or enqueue) and optional preferred-recommended auto-answering (requires the Todo Inbox component). A manually chosen away/offline state survives plugin reloads and Host restarts.
